description: This file defines function prototypes, data structures, macros, and inline functions related to command help and listing commands in a command-line interface, likely part of a larger project for command management or a tool similar to Git.

methods.name: cmdnames_release
methods.description: Releases resources associated with cmdnames structure.

methods.name: void mput_char(char c,unsigned int num)
methods.description: Outputs a character multiple times to standard output.

methods.name: list_common_cmds_help
methods.description: Prints help information for common commands.

methods.name: list_all_cmds_help
methods.description: Displays help for all commands, with options to show external commands and aliases.

methods.name: list_guides_help
methods.description: Prints help about available guides.

methods.name: list_user_interfaces_help
methods.description: Prints help for user interfaces.

methods.name: list_developer_interfaces_help
methods.description: Prints help for developer interfaces.

methods.name: list_all_main_cmds
methods.description: Lists all main commands.

methods.name: list_all_other_cmds
methods.description: Lists all other commands.

methods.name: list_cmds_by_category
methods.description: Lists commands filtered by category.

methods.name: list_cmds_by_config
methods.description: Lists commands filtered by configuration.

methods.name: help_unknown_cmd
methods.description: Returns help message for unknown commands.

methods.name: load_command_list
methods.description: Loads a list of commands with a prefix.

methods.name: load_builtin_commands
methods.description: Loads built-in commands into a command name list.

methods.name: add_cmdname
methods.description: Adds a command name to the cmdnames structure.

methods.name: exclude_cmds
methods.description: Excludes commands from a list based on a sorted exclude list.

methods.name: is_in_cmdlist
methods.description: Checks if a command is present in a command list.

methods.name: list_commands
methods.description: Lists commands from main and other command lists.

methods.name: get_version_info
methods.description: Retrieves version info and build options.

methods.name: help_unknown_ref
methods.description: Displays suggested correct command references when a command is mistyped.

methods.name: void list_config_item(struct string_list * list,const char * prefix,const char * str)
methods.description: Adds a configuration item with a prefix to a string list.

methods.name: list_config_advices
methods.description: Lists configuration advice items.

methods.name: list_config_color_branch_slots
methods.description: Lists color slots for branch names.

methods.name: list_config_color_decorate_slots
methods.description: Lists color slots for decorate output.

methods.name: list_config_color_diff_slots
methods.description: Lists color slots for diff output.

methods.name: list_config_color_grep_slots
methods.description: Lists color slots for grep output.

methods.name: list_config_color_interactive_slots
methods.description: Lists color slots for interactive prompts.

methods.name: list_config_color_status_slots
methods.description: Lists color slots for status output.

methods.name: list_config_color_sideband_slots
methods.description: Lists color slots for sideband output.

methods.name: list_config_fsck_msg_ids
methods.description: Lists message IDs for fsck.

ctags.name: len
ctags.pattern: /^		size_t len; \/* also used for similarity index in help.c *\/$/

ctags.name: list_config_item
ctags.signature: (struct string_list * list,const char * prefix,const char * str)

ctags.name: mput_char
ctags.pattern: /^static inline void mput_char(char c, unsigned int num)$/
